provenance.author: Airalogy
provenance.build_reference: Source-included data-only export inbox reader; not a vendor control adapter
sources: Public export-completion.v1 specification; independent synthetic file acceptance

commands.name: Collect a specifically identified completed file export
effects: Read only the selected export UUID directory and its fixed result.csv/export.json files
Copy raw bytes through the preapproved Platform draft asset intake; no source file modification
commands.completion: The exact producer completion receipt, sample reference, original byte sizes and SHA-256 digests match; this is file collection, not experimental success
commands.stop: Stop waiting/reading locally; no physical process is controlled. The Gateway separately confirms the read worker exited.

limitations: No vendor API, hardware startup, configuration or physical stop implementation
Qualification identifies the selected local inbox/reader, not live instrument firmware or scientific validity
A reviewed producer or explicit operator handoff must close files and atomically publish the completion receipt last
No latest-file guessing, arbitrary directory scanning, automatic format conversion or Record submission
POSIX local storage under the dedicated account only; Windows ACLs and network filesystems are not qualified
